name: GBEM-UA
description: A benchmark for measuring gender bias in Ukrainian large language models, addressing the complexities introduced by the gendered nature of the Ukrainian language and feminitives. It evaluates bias and the effectiveness of various debiasing methods including prompt debiasing, embedding debiasing, and fine-tuning.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark for Ukrainian LLM bias evaluation, primarily relevant to researchers working on fairness and debiasing in morphologically rich languages.
notes: Focuses on gender bias evaluation in a morphologically rich language; embedding debiasing alone is insufficient, fine-tuning is more effective.
